channel.title: Support :: Salix Documentation
channel.description: If you are still quite new to either Salix, Slackware or even Linux in general, then you should first of all take some time to study this guide, as it is specifically intended to be accessible to newcomers. The desktop link, Salix Online, will bring you to the Salix Homepage. You could also use the IRC link to be in live communication with members of the community and get instant help if necessary.
